57: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException is only supported on a class");
58: 			return;
59: 		}
60: 		
61: 		JCTree extending = Javac.getExtendsClause((JCClassDecl) typeNode.get());
62: 		if (extending == null) {
63: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException requires that you extend a Throwable type");
64: 			return;
65: 		}
66: 		
67: 		AccessLevel access = annotation.getInstance().access();
68: 		if (access == null) access = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;

75: 		generateMsgOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);

77: 		generateFullConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);

86: 		JCMethodDecl constr = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, false, source, List.of(thisCall));
87: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
88: 	}

108: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(msgExpression, maker.Ident(causeName));

115: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
116: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
117: 		
118: 		Name causeName = typeNode.toName("cause");
119: 		Name superName = typeNode.toName("super");

131: 		node = upToTypeNode(node);

134: 			for (JCTree def : ((JCClassDecl) node.get()).defs) {

139: 						return getGeneratedBy(def) == null ? MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_USER : MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_LOMBOK;

141: 				}

143: 		}
144: 		
145: 		return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;

148: 	private static boolean paramsMatch(JavacNode node, List<JCVariableDecl> a, Class<?>[] b) {
149: 		if (a == null) return b == null || b.length == 0;
150: 		if (b == null) return a.size() == 0;
151: 		if (a.size() != b.length) return false;
152: 		
153: 		for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
154: 			JCVariableDecl param = a.get(i);
155: 			Class<?> c = b[i];
156: 			if (!typeMatches(c, node, param.vartype)) return false;

159: 		return true;

163: 		if (!msgParam && !causeParam) return;
164: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = node.getTreeMaker();
165: 		JCExpression constructorPropertiesType = chainDots(node, "java", "beans", "ConstructorProperties");
166: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> fieldNames = new ListBuffer<JCExpression>();
167: 		if (msgParam) fieldNames.append(maker.Literal("message"));
168: 		if (causeParam) fieldNames.append(maker.Literal("cause"));
169: 		JCExpression fieldNamesArray = maker.NewArray(null, List.<JCExpression>nil(), fieldNames.toList());
170: 		JCAnnotation annotation = maker.Annotation(constructorPropertiesType, List.of(fieldNamesArray));
171: 		mods.annotations = mods.annotations.append(annotation);
172: 	}

175: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
176: 		
177: 		boolean addConstructorProperties;
178: 		if ((!msgParam && !causeParam) || isLocalType(typeNode) || !LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(typeNode.getContext()).getFormatPreferences().generateConstructorProperties()) {
179: 			addConstructorProperties = false;
180: 		} else {
181: 			Boolean v = typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_ADD_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES);
182: 			addConstructorProperties = v != null ? v.booleanValue() :
183: 				Boolean.FALSE.equals(typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_SUPPRESS_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES));
184: 		}
185: 		
186: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
187: 		
188: 		if (msgParam) {
189: 			Name fieldName = typeNode.toName("message");
190: 			long flags = JavacHandlerUtil.addFinalIfNeeded(Flags.PARAMETER, typeNode.getContext());
191: 			JCExpression pType = genJavaLangTypeRef(typeNode, "String");
192: 			JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), fieldName, pType, null);
193: 			params.append(param);
194: 		}
195: 		
196: 		if (causeParam) {
197: 			Name fieldName = typeNode.toName("cause");
198: 			long flags = JavacHandlerUtil.addFinalIfNeeded(Flags.PARAMETER, typeNode.getContext());
199: 			JCExpression pType = genJavaLangTypeRef(typeNode, "Throwable");
200: 			JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), fieldName, pType, null);
201: 			params.append(param);
202: 		}
203: 		
204: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(level), List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
205: 		if (addConstructorProperties) addConstructorProperties(mods, typeNode, msgParam, causeParam);
206: 		return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"),
207: 			null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(),
208: 			maker.Block(0L, statements), null), source);
209: 	}

213: 		if (kind == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return false;
214: 		if (kind == Kind.TYPE) return isLocalType(type.up());
